text:
maya: Short thread to lock GA scope. We need explicit callouts for: SLA applicability, long-context beta policy, docs for private installs, billing dispute flow, and launch telemetry. Assign pls.

rachel: I'll take the long-context beta policy + customer-facing paragraph. My proposal: long-context models (>2048 tokens) are "Beta Performance" - labeled, not SLA-covered, available behind a feature flag for pilots.

tom: I'll own SLA wording. Quick ask: do we want a single number per tier or a matrix by model family + input size? I prefer matrix.

dmitri: I'll make the matrix (model_family | token_bucket | covered_by_SLA | p99_target | fallback_variant). I'll include an explicit row for "long-context (beta)" = not covered.

jess: Docs owner for private install + air-gap notes. Will add sample systemd unit, KMS env vars, and an audit-log query example. ETA: Thu.

maya: Billing dispute flow — map to billing-oncall for 24h ack, then product-policy for exceptions. Also want an SLA-exclusions FAQ entry. Who will draft?

billing-bot: FYI: finance needs language on pilot burst credits: "Pilot credits expire 30 days after GA or earlier with notice" and a usage table example.

tom: SLA draft idea: Hosted SLOs (soft): p50/p95/p99 as SLOs; Dedicated: contractual p99 with credits. Also add clause: "SLA applies only to Redwood-verified models with input length <= 1024 tokens unless otherwise noted."

rachel: For customer messaging I'll add a short snippet: "Beta models may show variable latency; opt-in required. No SLA credits while in beta."

dmitri: Adding a fallback_policy field so on overload we route to smaller model variant automatically. I'll sketch an automated downgrade plan in the matrix.

jess: Docs will include a quick troubleshooting snippet:
```
# check KV cache status
redwood-admin kvcache status --instance private-1
```
and an audit query example for token usage per-route.

maya: Telemetry checklist for flip: synthetic p99 probes for top-10 routes, per-route token-cost metric, rollout-correlation dashboard, and billing spike alert. Owners?

dmitri: I'll wire synthetic probes and rollout correlation dashboard.

no one: (typing)

tom: I'll attach the p99 alert runbook: 1) validate probe, 2) check model variant rollout, 3) rollback if correlated, 4) scale pool or open eng-runtime page.

rachel: I'll coordinate wording with Support for the Beta label so reps can triage customer questions.

billing-bot: Logged: pilot-burst 1M tokens, auto-convert to metered billing after pilot or on GA; finance will provide exact contract language.

jess: I'll post docs PR link when available. Expect reviewer by Fri.

maya: Acceptance gate for me: SLA matrix in repo + legal ack, private-install docs merged, telemetry alerts live with runbooks, billing clause approved, Beta policy published. Reply "ack + ETA".

rachel: ack Tue EOD (beta policy + messaging).

jak: ack (typo)

tom: ack Wed EOD (SLA draft).

dmitri: ack Wed EOD (matrix + probes).

jess: ack Thu AM (docs PR).

billing-bot: ack Thu EOD (finance language queued).

deploy-bot: reminder: pre-GA staging run scheduled 2025-11-07T08:00Z, includes synthetic p99 and billing smoke tests. :robot_face: 

maya: Cool. If anything needs reassign, call it out here. Otherwise I'll mark owners in the launch doc and begin legal loop once Tom posts the draft. :rocket:
